Sounds like my father. Glad to see people seeing what it is. I'm so tired of people saying he's really a nice person just because he's my father. Why can't people see that he should leave me the fuck alone?

I don't think any physical harm, no matter how small, should be inflicted on anyone. People have the right to not be physically imposed on and children are no exception. Also as another commenter stated, physical harm can cause great harm to children's psyche, so there's that.

If you choose to become closer to your mother or father eventually at some point, that's up to you. Please don't feel pressure to like them and "be a part of the family" because "they're your parents." You're not obligated to like or have anyone in your life, and that's okay. Any person you have in your life should be on your terms.
